! =====================================================================
! Script Cisco IOS - ACLs de Seguranca (RTR-AnaFashion - 2911)
! Projeto: SmartRetail Network (Ana Fashion) - UniFECAF
! Passo 7: Isolamento de CFTV (VLAN 30) e Politica Inter-VLAN
! =====================================================================

enable
configure terminal

! --- 1. ACL da VLAN 10 (VENDAS_PDV) ---
! Permite VLAN 20 (Servidor) e Internet; bloqueia VLAN 30 (CFTV), VLAN 40 (Wi-Fi) e VLAN 99 (Gerencia)
ip access-list extended ACL_VLAN10_IN
 permit ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.99.0 0.0.0.255
 permit ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 any
 exit

! --- 2. ACL da VLAN 30 (CFTV - Isolamento Estrito) ---
! Permite apenas comunicacao com VLAN 20 (NVR) e ICMP para proprio gateway; bloqueia todo o resto
ip access-list extended ACL_VLAN30_IN
 permit ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
 permit icmp 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.30.1
 deny ip any any
 exit

! --- 3. ACL da VLAN 40 (WLAN_MOVEL - Tablets e Maquininha POS) ---
! Permite VLAN 20 (Servidor) e Internet; bloqueia VLAN 30 (CFTV), VLAN 10 (PDV) e VLAN 99 (Gerencia)
! Nota futura: para liberar impressora aos tablets, inserir antes do deny da 192.168.10.0:
! permit ip 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.10.10
ip access-list extended ACL_VLAN40_IN
 permit ip 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.99.0 0.0.0.255
 permit ip 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255 any
 exit

! --- 4. Aplicar ACLs na Entrada (in) das Sub-interfaces ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 ip access-group ACL_VLAN10_IN in
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
 ip access-group ACL_VLAN30_IN in
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.40
 ip access-group ACL_VLAN40_IN in
 exit

! --- 5. Salvar Configuracao ---
end
write memory
